notes.notes:

notes.title: Plans for the future: Free DLC, Movement changes, bug fixes and more
notes.notes:
Plans for the future of Freedom's eye include:

A free DLC that will properly extend the playtime of Freedom's eye to 1 hour+.
It will mainly focus on exploring the part of the game that was cut: Vosos, the undercity.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41659286/bf233673429ef60053a79531d16063d22776361b.png[/img]
The planned release is Semptember/October


Movement changes and bug fixes:

So, the 2 things that are going to be released with the DLC are the movement changes and bug fixes.
The main focus of the movement changes is to slow down the player so the player can no longer run and to make conversation with the characters faster which makes the interactions with the characters a lot more enjoyable.
Slowing down the player movement also gives the game the room to breathe and removes all soft locks.


Saving:
Yeah, that will be added. Nothing much to say.

Linux version:
This is for that one guy who whishlisted my game even thought they are using linux and my game is only available for windows. 
Yes, I will make a linux version for you… you know who you are O_O .


What will happen after I release the DLC?

Well, shortly after release it I am probably going to be fixing any unforeseen bugs for a week after release.
What happens after that will be conected to Freedom's eye and the DLC and... well... Eye cannot say for certain.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41659286/0f66cec50e3635fc8536b3fde9a474b9c0410afb.png[/img]

If I am not able to release the DLC and everything else by start of November then it will probably be released in February.

Have a nice day.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41659286/724fbbdf2d9a7e80eec66fa2ceea5c8d4624218e.png[/img]

notes.title: Release date of Freedom's eye
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
I have decided to delay the realase of Freedom's eye to June 20th .
The 2 reasons for the delay are :
1.Unexpected audio and visual bugs(primarly on low spec devices).
2.Some much needed improvment to the visuals of the game.
As you can see (the last gif in the game description),the diffrence between the original planned look and current look is night and day.


My main thoughts are that, in the end, I want to realease the game that I am proud of and everyone can enjoy so I hope you can wait a little longer.

Hope everyone is doing well, cheers.
